mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rate levels (FEDFUNDS) reduce the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and increasing present value of future cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 20-year median, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in labor market (PAYEMS growth) and housing demand (HOUST) indicates robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days through joint economic expansion.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * HOUST) has Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive return signal occurs in less than 45% of instances where both series are above 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: High economic growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%) combined with elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals imminent monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high growth and high inflation regime
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), or Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and dampening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST > 1200 thousand units) reflect strong consumer demand and economic confidence, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200 thousand units, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Tight labor market conditions (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 158000) fuel consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the tight labor market condition (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 158000), or Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.02.
